ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white/yellowish) pixel clusters localized at tips and sparse spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black contiguous region covering >90% of the fluke surface; high-contrast yellowish-white clusters mapped to the distal lateral tips; sparse distribution of white circular spots (1-5 pixels) in the ventral-central regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate 65-degree internal angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations with an amplitude of 3-10 pixels along the entire visible trailing edge boundary, isolated from the dark water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve along the trailing edge leading to pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density yellowish-white pixel clusters at both the left and right distal tips; isolated white circular clusters scattered in the lower-medial quadrants of the visible surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal linear white mark (~40 pixels length) on the medial portion of the right lobe; secondary shorter, fainter linear marks detected on the same lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization at both lateral tips; multiple linear scratch marks (rake marks) on the right fluke lobe.
